assets.label: workshop hoists and press
assets.service: heavy vehicle component removal and pressing

control_failures.control_label: preparation and approval of a lift study

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: high potential incident during a statutory inspection on HO-9403

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the preparation and approval of a lift study on HO-9403 and M-9403 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically selecting and inspecting lifting gear. HO-9403 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the preparation and approval of a lift study had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 14 May 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on HO-9403 and M-9403 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a statutory inspection; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
